unapplied_findings.fact: Both named perception64/65 cases derive their positive and negative cardinality from ResourceLimit::PerceptionCandidates.maximum without an independent64 assertion.
unapplied_findings.inference: Those two assertions alone cannot detect a coordinated change of the policy constant while algorithm behavior stays consistent. No production mutation was executed and no whole-suite survival is claimed.
unapplied_findings.recommendation: If64 is an independently accepted stable contract, pin it in one retained owner/compatibility test after contract trace and focused mutation qualification.

unapplied_findings.fact: evaluation_exhaustion_and_route_byte_overflow_publish_no_result rejects usize::MAX on its first route element through capacity, before cumulative arithmetic overflow.
unapplied_findings.recommendation: Describe the actual capacity oracle accurately; generic ResourceLimit::admit has a separate direct arithmetic-overflow test. No removal is proposed merely from the name.
